info.name: D4 Track B - Simple
info.description: D4 Track B REST API: 24 endpoints, organized by resource. All saved response examples are ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT EXECUTED test evidence. Run the backend separately. Send requests individually, not as an automatic collection run. Set test_* IDs from newly created records before PUT/DELETE. Financial writes need dedicated SQL fixtures because this API has no membership/cycle creation endpoints. Keep real execution evidence separately in the validation/security test log. No authentication required for D4. Allowed browser origin by default: http://localhost:5173. CORS does not authenticate callers. Rate limit defaults to 100 requests per IP per minute.

Do not repeatedly submit this POST expecting 201.
